title: Whole-bps slippage cap shown before submission
description: Focused AC2 feedback proof on the prepared Terminal slot. No wallet connection or orders. Unit tests cover the deterministic live-depth rejection boundary.

proofTargets.claim: The maximum-slippage field displays the same whole-bps cap used at submission.

launch.intent: Open the prepared testnet Terminal without placing orders

ready.intent: Confirm the trader can configure execution tolerance before submitting

fractional-cap.intent: Choose a one-basis-point maximum before refining its precision

effective-cap.intent: Verify the field shows the conservative one-basis-point cap

amount.intent: Request a live-depth estimate without submitting

estimate.intent: Verify the live estimate appears beside the effective cap

capture.intent: Keep a picture of the estimate and whole-bps maximum

fractional-digit.intent: Add fractional precision to the execution tolerance
